preconditions.description: Attacker must be the owner of the MelodyToken contract

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call the mint() function with your own address as the recipient and a large amount (up to the remaining supply limit). This will mint new MELODY tokens directly to your address, increasing your balance without any cost. The vulnerability is that the owner can arbitrarily mint tokens to themselves or others, manipulating reward allocation and token supply.
